{{Quote|My son is an engineer at those shipyards. You saved his life|Clento Rone thanking Voidhound|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Clento Rone''' was a [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. After the [[Voidhound]] defeated the [[Harridax Kirill|Voidwolf]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]], Clento thanked the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] for saving his [[Clento Rone's son|son]] who worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] in the Republic shipyards.
